quotes.name: Elio Perez
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund, and honestly, I’m just hoping it reaches the people who really need it—families like mine who’ve been holding on tight.

quotes.name: Daniel Cloak
quotes.quote: I've heard folks at the bakery talking about the Stabilization Fund like it's supposed to help, but honestly, I don't see much changing on my block yet. People still struggling same as before.

quotes.name: Irene Fay
quotes.quote: I’ve heard people talking about the Stabilization Fund at the coffee shop, mostly wondering how it’s going to help the neighborhood directly.

quotes.name: Darius Clark
quotes.quote: I’ve heard folks talking about the Stabilization Fund at the bakery, but I haven’t seen much change around here yet.
